description.value: Tofino Water Taxi runs the electric vessel Silent 1 out of Tofino, offering on-demand charters and bundled excursions (including an 'Ahous Bay Direct' round trip to Ahousaht/Flores Island, from $99–119) rather than a fixed timetable — Ahousaht's own community directory names Ahous Hakuum as the only water taxi with regular scheduled service to the community. No bicycle policy is published; kayak transport is offered. Call ahead to confirm bike space and cost.
